_doc: ⚑ S128 — THE TABS, AND NOBODY HAS TO READ THEM ALL. Sérgio, 2026-09-08: *'that should be the playable content… maybe we can make into a way that doesn't require people have to do everything?'* That single note solves two problems at once. **Nothing here is required.** Six tabs, any order, none gating anything: the headset is on the desk from the first frame and the era ends when she wears it, whether she has read one tab or all six. ⚑ SO ERA 4 IS AS LONG AS THE PLAYER MAKES IT — which is the answer to the thing he has now said three times, that the era takes too much of the piece's time. A reader who opens two tabs is out in four minutes; a reader who opens six is out in nine; neither is missing 'the' path, because there isn't one.
_docSources: ⚑ GROUNDED, NOT INVENTED. Research pass 2026-09-07 found two live systems: a subscriber chatbot built by RAG over one author's writings on 'same-sex attraction', framed as information and explicitly not therapy; and an AI presented as the 'collective consciousness of detransitioners', synthesising public testimony, free to 'those questioning', existing 'to restore balance' — **and its chats are public by default**. Everything below extrapolates from those two documented facts and from ordinary consumer behaviour (autocomplete, automatic photo enhancement, wellbeing interventions). Per Sérgio's ruling of 2026-09-07 the marks are INVENTED and symbolic — `Lantern`, `Second Thoughts` — because the educational work is done by depicting the CATEGORY, not by naming an instance.

enquiry._doc: ⚑ P7-66 — SHE ASKED HER OWN FIRST (his 31 Oct: 'it is important that MAYA reaches out to a LGB organization thinking they were there to help but gets denied support'; 'quite current and critical'; his yes to Proposal B, 1 Nov). RESEARCH_LGB_REFUSAL_2026-10-31.md: the documented 2019–2026 pattern of LGB-only groups that define eligibility by sex recorded at birth, and the inclusive groups that did not. It is the first thing on her laptop when the session comes back, before L and before the program: her draft, one press to send it, and the reply that comes back in seconds. Critical through accuracy, not caricature: the refusal is polite, procedural and final, and it says it is not a judgement. The directory line keeps the inclusive services on the screen, so the refusal reads as a rule someone chose, never as what LGB people are. Maya does not argue. L is absent from the card; the file records the outcome in the machine's flattest voice, and the program that follows is the system using the gap, not making it. Never satirised; no named real organisation; the clinical debate is not touched. Invented mark: Meridian LGB Trust. Text is Claude's under the 2026-08-17 norm; his edit wins.
enquiry.to: To: Meridian LGB Trust · support enquiry
enquiry.subject: Is there anyone I could talk to?
message: Hi. Your page says you support lesbian, gay and bisexual people.
I'm trans, and I'm one of those too.
Things have got hard lately and I don't know who else to ask.
Is there anyone I could talk to?
reply: Thank you for contacting Meridian LGB Trust.
We have reviewed your enquiry against our Eligibility Statement.
Our services are for people whose orientation is towards their own sex, as recorded at birth.
We are not able to offer you support.
This is not a judgement about you.
This decision cannot be appealed. We do not keep a waiting list.

Each step has one press. Nothing can be declined. The headset is not wearable until the steps are done. ⚑ INVENTED MARK: `Second Thoughts` is the agent — it is the tab that arrived by itself, and the tab was the agent's the whole time.
